I don't think the problem is people not being able to downvoat as much as the ranking system not being calibrated for a much smaller user base. Assuming they copied reddit's system, which is probably a safe assumption, the rank is based on not only up/down voats but also when it's posted. You can effectively think of it as a time based ranking where upvoats move the post forward in time (makes the post rank as if it was posted more recently). The problem here is the voating term is dwarfed by the time term of the ranking equation, so posts are essentially ranked only by time, with the exception of a few popular submissions. Basically, /v/all is behaving a lot like a small sub, where all the submissions are basically just ranked by time posted.
